short: first char of split Chinese verb
notes: Card: 煽 x2, 抒 x2, 展, 培, 翻, 誘導, 創造 — verb-initial characters. Probe: 煽动 0.702, 抒发 0.565; 诱导 (one token) 0.097, 创造 (one token) 0.002, same sentences without the verb ~0.01. Tokenizer: 斟酌, 揣摩, 怂恿, 唆使, 蛊惑, 鼓动 split; 激发, 表达, 描写 single tokens.
